name: Technics
verdict: Technics, the Hi-Fi audio brand of Panasonic (Panasonic Holdings group). Nothing found.
aliases: パナソニック テクニクス
note: Kit sponsor (front, collarbone area) of Gamba Osaka 2026-27 per the club's uniform launch page; the club lists it as 'Panasonic Co., Ltd. Technics'. Rating note: Technics is a Panasonic brand and trademark; Panasonic Holdings' top holders are trust banks and institutions with no controlling state holder. No human-rights finding against the company was found.
